display_name: Generali Corporate / 忠利集团企业报告风格

user_reference_decks: 开门红储蓄型保险的“人、货、场”V2（广州AIA）.pptx
provenance.note: Engineering approximation, not an official licensed brand book.

color_rules: Use brand red for conclusion, KPI emphasis and focal data series.
Use white/light neutral backgrounds for analytical pages.
Use charcoal body text; avoid red paragraphs.
Exact HEX values are approximations and must be calibrated from source assets.

typography.title: Strong sans-serif, short declarative conclusion
typography.numbers: Tabular numerals and oversized key figures

iconography.style: One consistent line-icon or restrained solid geometric family
iconography.stroke: Consistent stroke weight and optical size
iconography.semantic_rule: Icons encode category or action, never decorate empty space
iconography.density_rule: Use icons for repeated taxonomies/process nodes; avoid one-off icon clutter

principles: Choose chart from analytical question, not aesthetic preference.
Use red for focal series and neutral greys for context.
Direct-label values and units when it reduces legend lookup.
Show baseline, period, scope and source.
Use small multiples for segment comparisons.
Encode actuals, targets and forecasts consistently.

information_architecture.high_density_rule: Increase capacity through grouping, hierarchy, direct labels and spatial structure; do not solve by shrinking fonts.
review_derived_rules: Use conclusion-led title; do not let a chart or process diagram become the title's substitute.
For dense customer segmentation and taxonomy, separate classification logic from detailed field/value examples.
For omnichannel process slides, make online/offline boundaries, stage direction and conversion outcomes explicit.
For multi-step digital workflows, use progressive stages and keep each node to a short action phrase.
For bilingual system maps, keep language roles consistent and avoid mixing translated prose with tiny labels.

anti_patterns: equal-weight card grids when one conclusion should dominate
red text on pale red with insufficient contrast
repeated index slides without narrative purpose

quality_gates.source_basis: Provisional visual expert review of 16 GCL reference pages, 2026-11-19; not yet independently human-adjudicated.

minimum_text_readability.rule: These are initial PPT canvas thresholds; override only when the projected viewing context is explicitly specified.

annotation_hygiene: Remove reviewer/editorial annotations from final slides.
Do not introduce blue instruction text into the red/white/charcoal brand system unless it is semantically encoded and approved.
density: Do not reduce font size as the first response to overflow.
When a matrix/process page exceeds legible node text or has more than 8 dense modules, recommend splitting or progressive disclosure.
chart_legibility: Keep axis labels, units, time periods and source readable at presentation scale.
Use direct labels or small multiples when legend/axis lookup becomes burdensome.
Differentiate actual, forecast and target with consistent encodings.
composition: Keep title anchor and page margins consistent.
Remove unexplained black placeholders, stray marks and decorative-only icons.
